summary: Union County, IL Shawnee National Forest lookout: 1942 Forest Service station with a 100-ft steel tower; 1972 notice to sell it with seven others; now marked gone.

facts.status_note: FFLA Illinois list marks it gone; the sources read give no removal date and do not describe the site now

events.note: Described as a Forest Service lookout station with a 100-foot steel tower and excellent view, near Giant City State Park, visitors welcome (dated 1942 on the Forest Lookouts page)

notes_for_editor: The 1972 sale notice is the same text the Williams Hill page quotes; it refers to this tower and seven others without naming them, so the list of eight is not confirmed. The record height of 30.5 m matches the 1942 figure of 100 feet. The 1942 text on the Forest Lookouts page is attributed there to an Illinois Ozark region county-names source; that original was not read. No build date, staffing or fire history in the sources read. The Shawnee National Forest attribution comes from the Forest Lookouts page heading. Nothing read describes the site today.
